section: NITI Aayog initiatives - SDG India Index, Aspirational Districts Programme, Health/Education indices, Atal Innovation Mission
subsections: NITI flagship reports - Strategy for New India @75, Viksit Bharat documents
AP rank in other NITI indices

accepted.s: Strategy for New India @75 was released in which year?
accepted.x: Strategy for New India @75 was released in 2018.
accepted.tq: Use the year-specific direct-recall approach for flagship reports.
accepted.sec: NITI flagship reports - Strategy for New India @75, Viksit Bharat documents

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding the planning framework associated with NITI Aayog:
1. It comprises a 15-year Vision.
2. It includes a 7-year Strategy.
3. It includes a 3-year Action Agenda.
4. The framework was introduced in 2016.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: The framework introduced in 2016 consists of a 15-year Vision, a 7-year Strategy and a 3-year Action Agenda.
accepted.tq: Combine related numerical details in a coded statement question.
accepted.sec: NITI flagship reports - Strategy for New India @75, Viksit Bharat documents

accepted.s: Under the State Support Mission, the States are expected to prepare which of the following documents in alignment with Viksit Bharat @2047?
accepted.x: Under the State Support Mission, States prepare State Vision@2047 documents in line with Viksit Bharat @2047.
accepted.tq: Test the exact official terminology rather than a familiar substitute phrase.
accepted.sec: NITI flagship reports - Strategy for New India @75, Viksit Bharat documents

accepted.s: The document titled ‘Swarna Andhra @2047’ represents Andhra Pradesh’s version of which broader vision?
accepted.x: Swarna Andhra @2047 is Andhra Pradesh’s State Vision@2047 document aligned with Viksit Bharat @2047.
accepted.tq: Discriminate between similarly framed long-term national visions.
accepted.sec: NITI flagship reports - Strategy for New India @75, Viksit Bharat documents

accepted.s: According to the Fiscal Health Index data for 2023-24, what was the rank of Andhra Pradesh?
accepted.x: Andhra Pradesh was ranked 17th in the Fiscal Health Index for 2023-24.
accepted.tq: Use the exact rank and financial year instead of confusing it with another NITI ranking.
accepted.sec: AP rank in other NITI indices  [GROUP-II]

accepted.s: What was Andhra Pradesh’s rank in the Export Preparedness Index 2022?
accepted.x: Andhra Pradesh secured the 8th rank in the Export Preparedness Index 2022.
accepted.tq: Separate the index year from the rank and reject nearby-rank distractors.
accepted.sec: AP rank in other NITI indices  [GROUP-II]

accepted.s:
With reference to Andhra Pradesh’s performance in the SDG India Index 2023-24, consider the following statements:
1. Andhra Pradesh ranked 9th overall.
2. Andhra Pradesh ranked first in SDG 7.
3. Andhra Pradesh ranked second in SDG 14.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: In the SDG India Index 2023-24, Andhra Pradesh ranked 9th overall, first in SDG 7 and second in SDG 14.
accepted.tq: Test an overall rank together with goal-specific ranks to prevent reversal of comparisons.
accepted.sec: AP rank in other NITI indices  [GROUP-II]

accepted.s: Which of the following correctly describes Andhra Pradesh’s position in the SDG India Index 2023-24?
o: 9th overall, 1st in SDG 7 and 2nd in SDG 14
4th overall, 1st in SDG 7 and 2nd in SDG 14
1st overall, 9th in SDG 7 and 14th in SDG 14
17th overall, 2nd in SDG 7 and 1st in SDG 14
accepted.x: Andhra Pradesh stood 9th overall, first in SDG 7 and second in SDG 14 in the SDG India Index 2023-24.
accepted.tq: Read the overall and component rankings in the same order to avoid reversed comparisons.
accepted.sec: AP rank in other NITI indices  [GROUP-II]

accepted.s: Which of the following best explains the significance of NITI Aayog’s indices?
o: They exclusively rank cities according to their population size.
They measure only the financial performance of the Union Government.
They replace State governments in implementing all development programmes.
They make competitive federalism measurable and translate national goals into district-level outcomes.
accepted.x: NITI indices make competitive federalism measurable and help convert national goals into district-level outcomes.
accepted.tq: Identify the option that states both the institutional significance and the development-outcome dimension.

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements about recent NITI Aayog indices in 2026:
1. The Fiscal Health Index 2026 is the second edition.
2. The Investment Friendliness Index was associated with July 2026.
3. The second edition of the India Electric Mobility Index was associated with September 2026.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: The Fiscal Health Index 2026 was in its second edition, the Investment Friendliness Index was associated with July 2026, and the second India Electric Mobility Index was associated with September 2026.
accepted.tq: Pair each index with its edition or release month before evaluating the statements.

accepted.s: Which one of the following statements correctly describes the change in Andhra Pradesh’s overall SDG ranking and its Fiscal Health Index position?
o: Its SDG rank fell from 4th to 9th and it ranked 17th in the Fiscal Health Index.
Its SDG rank improved from 9th to 4th and it ranked 17th in the Fiscal Health Index.
Its SDG rank fell from 17th to 9th and it ranked 4th in the Fiscal Health Index.
Its SDG rank remained 4th and it ranked 9th in the Fiscal Health Index.
accepted.x: Andhra Pradesh’s overall SDG rank fell from 4th to 9th, while its Fiscal Health Index rank was 17th.
accepted.tq: Track the direction of change first, then match the separate index rank.

accepted.s: The second India Electric Mobility Index was launched by which two organisations?
o: WRI India and the Asian Development Bank
NITI Aayog and the World Bank
Ministry of Heavy Industries and NITI Aayog
accepted.x: NITI Aayog and WRI India launched the second India Electric Mobility Index in September 2026.
accepted.tq: Apply the ‘who launched or developed it?’ authority trap.

accepted.s: In the India Electric Mobility Index, which of the following correctly represents the relative weights of its components?
o: Transport electrification 50%, charging infrastructure 30%, EV research and innovation 20%
Transport electrification 30%, charging infrastructure 50%, EV research and innovation 20%
Transport electrification 50%, charging infrastructure 20%, EV research and innovation 30%
Transport electrification 20%, charging infrastructure 30%, EV research and innovation 50%
accepted.x: The index assigns 50% to transport electrification, 30% to charging infrastructure and 20% to EV research and innovation.
accepted.tq: Match each percentage with its component and watch for reversed weightings.

accepted.s: The India Electric Mobility Index comprises how many indicators?
accepted.x: The India Electric Mobility Index is based on 16 indicators.
accepted.tq: Use the exact count rather than inferring it from the percentage weights.

accepted.s: Which of the following statements regarding multidimensional poverty in India is correct?
o: It declined from 55.3% in 2005-06 to 14.96% in 2019-21 and was estimated at 11.28% in 2022-23.
It increased from 14.96% in 2005-06 to 55.3% in 2019-21.
It declined from 14.96% in 2005-06 to 11.28% in 2019-21.
It remained unchanged at 55.3% between 2005-06 and 2019-21.
accepted.x: National multidimensional poverty fell from 55.3% in 2005-06 to 14.96% in 2019-21 and was estimated at 11.28% in 2022-23.
accepted.tq: Check the time sequence and direction of the trend before comparing percentages.

accepted.s: Approximately how many people left multidimensional poverty during 2015-21?
accepted.x: An estimated 135 million people left multidimensional poverty during 2015-21.
accepted.tq: Test the exact magnitude associated with the poverty-reduction outcome.

accepted.s: Which district of Andhra Pradesh was reported to have secured the national first position in basic infrastructure under the Aspirational Districts Programme?
accepted.x: Alluri Sitharama Raju district secured the national first position in basic infrastructure under the Aspirational Districts Programme.
accepted.tq: Use the location-based recall method for a district-level achievement.

accepted.s:
Assertion (A): NITI Aayog indices can strengthen competitive federalism.
Reason (R): They provide measurable comparisons of development performance across States and help relate national goals to district-level outcomes.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
accepted.x: Both statements are true, and the measurable comparison of State performance and district-level outcomes explains how these indices strengthen competitive federalism.
accepted.tq: Test whether the reason directly explains the institutional significance stated in the assertion.
